jobs.title: Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
**REPORTS TO:**  Senior Pastor

**SUPERVISES:** N/A

**PART TIME:** 12 hrs./ week, Monday \- Thursday

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

The Communication Coordinator facilitates effective and consistent church communications among church staff, lay leadership, church volunteers, and church members in general, ensuring that church\-wide communications are accurate and constructive.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**:

**Communications:** 

* Coordinate information in weekly E\-mail news (Buzz), worship bulletin, and church sign.
* Coordinate with Chimes editorial team to ensure that the Chimes Quarterly newsletter is created and delivered on schedule.
* Build and manage the Church Directory
* Coordinate communication with committee chairs, volunteers, staff, and church members.
* Church website: Assists Office Administrator with creating an inviting and attractive website which includes content that agrees with all social media, and other church publicity, platforms.
* Coordinate preparation of special service materials (memorials, extra services, etc.)
* Assists with extra office administrative tasks (ie:new positions postings, interview scheduling, etc.)
* Assist with preparation for seasonal “all church” mailings.
* Become proficient in the Planning Center database, training congregation members as needed.
* Ensure our church social media and video posts are current. Create content as necessary.
* Assists Care Team with mailings and other communication needs

**Facility Rental:**

* Assist Office Administrator with facility use and rental requests as needed
* Assist Office Administrator with maintaining the monthly AUMC calendar.

**Prayer Wall:**

* Ensures that prayer wall posting happens smoothly and requests are appropriately screened.
* Notify pastors of relevant / urgent prayer chain information.

**Sunday Worship**:

* Coordinate preparation of worship materials (bulletins, scriptures, slides, etc.)
* Coordinate altar flowers.

**Other duties as assigned by the Senior Pastor**

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Familiarity with church operations.
* Strong grammatical skills, proofreading and editing, and copywriting
* Ability to use Microsoft Word and ability to learn how to use other office software.
* Familiarity with ProPresenter preferred.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse groups of people and maintain positive relations within the work and Church environment.
* Strong social media experience and knowledge.
* Graphic design and videography experience recommended.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud Suite preferred
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Pay: $21\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 12\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Account Management & Renewals Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Account Management \& Renewals Coordinator (Travel/Remote)****Sullivan on Comp** is a subscription\-based legal research and technology platform serving the California workers’ compensation industry. The sales team is also expanding its business\-development efforts for Cadence, an AI platform used by law firms and claims organizations to review and analyze workers’ compensation matters.  

Sullivan on Comp is seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented **Account Management \& Renewals Coordinator** to provide direct support to the Account Executive responsible for renewals, account management, customer retention, and account growth.  

The primary focus of this role is to ensure that renewals, customer requests, account changes, documentation, and follow\-up activities are handled accurately and on time, while promptly identifying matters that require Account Executive involvement.  

**Compensation:*** $29 – $35/hour ($60,320 – $72,800 annually)
* Annual performance incentive of 5% target / 7\.5% maximum
This position is classified as non\-exempt and is eligible for overtime in accordance with applicable law.  
* 
**Travel \& Work Location*** Candidate must reside in CA.
* This position can be performed primarily in a remote environment, with up to 15% \- 25% travel.
Travel may include but is not limited to 2\-3 meetings in SoCal Office, approximately 10 industry conferences or trade shows each lasting 2\-4 days, and additional occasional business travel on an as\-needed basis.  

* 

**Daily Objectives:*** Manage the end\-to\-end renewal process, including tracking upcoming renewals, coordinating customer communications, processing standard renewal requests, and maintaining accurate renewal status in HubSpot.
* Monitor customer accounts and proactively identify renewals, retention risks, account changes, or nonstandard situations requiring Account Executive involvement.
* Maintain accurate group\-account, subscription, billing, user, and account information while coordinating routine account updates with internal teams.
* Support customer retention and growth initiatives by identifying potential upgrade, expansion, and Cadence opportunities and escalating them to the Account Executive.
* Prepare quotes, contracts, renewal documents, account reviews, and related documentation while tracking outstanding forms, requests, and customer commitments through completion.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, customer interactions, renewal activities, forecasts, reports, and account\-status tracking to support informed decision\-making.
* Conduct routine customer follow\-up, respond to standard account and renewal inquiries, and help maintain engagement between strategic account conversations.
* Coordinate with Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of customer requests and a positive client experience.
* Provide actionable account intelligence by identifying upcoming renewals, accounts requiring attention, retention opportunities, and customer trends that support account management strategy.
Support industry conferences, trade shows, and firm events through event preparation, on\-site participation, customer engagement, lead follow\-up, and business travel as needed.  
* 
**Skills \& Experience:*** 2\+ years of experience in sales and/or business development in the Workers’ Compensation, Insurance, Legal Tech, SAAS, or similar Legal Services industry.
* Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM.
* Experience providing client activation and renewal support to account management, sales, or customer success teams.
* Strong organizational skills, highly detail\-oriented, excellent time management, and holding strong follow\-through abilities.
* Strong multi\-tasking abilities, ability to work independently, and proactively work as part of a team.
* Be comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, databases, and sales systems.
* Strong customer service and ability to communicate professionally on the phone and via email.
* Exercise good judgment regarding when an issue should be escalated.
Be willing and able to travel for conferences, trade shows, and firm meetings.  
* 

**Health \& Wellness*** Medical plan options including **Kaiser Permanente** HMO, **Cigna** EPO, and **Cigna** PPO
* Dental coverage through **Delta Dental** with DHMO and PPO options
* **Vision** coverage through VSP
* Firm\-Paid **Life/AD\&D** (up to $150k) \& Long\-term Disability ( **LTD** ) Insurance.
* Firm\-Paid Employee Assistance Program ( **EAP** ) offering confidential support.
**Retirement \& Voluntary Benefits*** **401(k)** retirement plan with employer contribution.
* **Critical Illness** , **Accident** , and **Hospital Indemnity Coverage** , available at group rates.
* Flexible Spending Account ( **FSA** ) and Dependent Care Assistance Program ( **DCAP** ) options for eligible pre\-tax expenses.
* Voluntary short\-term disability ( **STD** ) coverage.
* Supplemental **Life and AD\&D Insurance** .
* Optional **Pet Insurance** , because family comes in many forms.
  

*Sullivan on Comp provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic makeup, marital status, military service, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.*

jobs.title: Community Marketing Coordinator- Fatburger
jobs.description:
Description:

FAT Brands Inc is a leading global franchising company that develops and grows fast casual, quick\-service, and casual dining concepts around the world — a portfolio of 11 brands, including Round Table Pizza®, Fatburger, Marble Slab Creamery, Johnny Rockets, Fazoli’s, Great American Cookies, Buffalo’s Cafe \& Express, Hurricane Grill \& Wings, Native Grill \& Wings, Pretzelmaker, and Ponderosa and Bonanza Steakhouses, spanning more than 1,700 units worldwide.


The Community Marketing Coordinator is an integral part of the Fatburger Marketing team at FAT brands, responsible for bringing the brand to life at the local restaurant level. This role combines hands\-on execution with strategic problem\-solving, helping franchisees identify and activate marketing opportunities that drive traffic, build community connections, and support profitable sales growth.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and resourceful, with the ability to manage the details while also seeing the bigger picture. They should be comfortable working directly with franchises, navigating multiple priorities, and finding creative solutions when a playbook doesn't already exist.


This role will support local store marketing problems, new restaurant openings, community events, franchisee marketing requests and local partnerships while using market, competitive and sales insights to identify opportunities and recommend effective local marketing strategies.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  



* Assist in developing and executing local marketing plans that drive awareness, traffic and profitable sales, tailored to individual restaurant and market needs.
* Serve as a day\-to\-day marketing resource to franchisees, helping identify opportunities, develop market\-specific strategies and execute events, partnerships and community initiatives.
* Coordinate New Restaurant Marketing Plans and all marketing\-related activities from pre\-opening through launch.
* Lead local activations, events, and partnerships while ensuring all marketing remains on\-brand and aligned with broader Fatburger objectives.
* Coordinate creative requests from intake through final delivery, provide guidance on best practices and ensure franchisees have the tools and resources needed to execute effectively.
* Leverage sales, market and competitive data to identify opportunities, measure results and inform future local marketing strategies.
* Assists the Digital Team with CRM platforms, including websites, SMS, e\-clubs, and app\-based loyalty programs.
* Responsible for maintaining and updating ship lists, store location lists, and location listings management tools.
* Maintain budgets, project timelines, store/location information, marketing resources and other tools necessary to keep local programs organized and moving forward.
* Assists with Administrative Duties such as maintaining a budget, agendas, notes, and action items for meetings.


Requirements:  



* 2\+ years of marketing, local store marketing, franchise marketing, restaurant marketing or agency experience preferred.
* Experience working with franchisees, field teams, operators, or multiple stakeholders is a plus.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, deadlines and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both corporate teams and franchise partners.
* Highly resourceful and solutions\-oriented; comfortable figuring things out, navigating ambiguity and taking initiatives without being asked.
* Strategic thinker who can understand a business challenge, identify opportunities and recommend practical marketing solutions
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through, with the ability to move projects from idea to execution
* Comfortable working with basic sales, market and competitive data translating insights into actionable recommendations
* Strong relationship\-building skills and the confidence to work directly with franchisees and restaurant operators
* Creative thinker who understands how to make a national brand relevant within individual communities
* Proficiency with project management and marketing tools; experience with Asana, Google Business Profile, social platforms, CRM/loyalty platforms and third\-party delivery platforms is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**American Trading International, Inc (ATI)** is currently seeking a **Logistics Coordinator\-Export Documentation** to join our Logistics team in Los Angeles, CA.

American Trading International, Inc. (ATI) is a service\-oriented export trading company that brings U.S. food and beverage products to more than 80 markets worldwide. We are looking for a detail\-oriented Logistics Coordinator \- Export Documentation to support accurate, compliant, and timely international shipments.

**What You’ll Do**

* Prepare Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Bills of Lading, Certificates of Origin, FDA documents, and country\-specific export documents.
* Track document and order status to meet customer, carrier, and internal deadlines.
* Follow customer SOPs and international export\-documentation requirements.
* Coordinate with Sales, customers, carriers, trucking companies, warehouses, and internal teams.
* Identify documentation discrepancies and escalate delays or compliance risks.
* Support FDA filings, notarizations, legalizations, certificates, and telex releases.
* Maintain complete, accurate, and audit\-ready shipment records in SAP.
* Process documentation amendments and post\-shipment corrections.
* Support timely invoice submission and month\-end closing.

**What You’ll Bring**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Two to four years of logistics, export documentation, supply chain, customer service, or related experience.
* Knowledge of international shipping and export documentation.
* Strong attention to detail, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and time\-sensitive deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; SAP experience preferred.
* Positive, professional, and proactive approach to problem\-solving.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The hourly pay range is $24\.00 to $29\.00, commensurate with experience.

ATI offers bonus opportunities, 100% employer\-paid medical coverage for employees, dental, vision, life insurance, voluntary benefits, flexible spending accounts, matching 401(k), profit sharing, accrued PTO, and paid holidays.

ATI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Authorization to work in the United States is required.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $24\.00 \- $29\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

* Health insurance

* Vision insurance

jobs.description:

Assists with information maintenance and distribution by drafting integrative presentations, detailed correspondence, and reports. Facilitates workflow by assisting in the adaptation of relevant solutions and standard requests and issues from department managers on an ad\-hoc basis. Assists with event coordination by coordinating and calendaring meetings for directors and their direct teams, independently. * Pursues effective relationships across teams and/or the organization to obtain and share resources, information, and advice with coworkers and members. Listens to, addresses, and seeks performance feedback; acts as a mentor for less experienced team members. Pursues self\-development; creates plans to capitalize on strengths and develop weaknesses; reviews others work to help them learn. Adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback; demonstrates flexibility in work; helps others adapt to non\-routine situations. Identifies and responds to the needs of others to support the execution of varied work processes.

Supports the development of work plans to meet established priorities, deadlines, and expectations. jobs.description:
**Role description**  

Role \- Partnership Marketing Coordinator



Location \- Burbank, CA \- onsite



Rate \- $30/hr \- $33/hr



Client \- LTM



The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who is detail\-oriented, a quick learner, and brings a can\-do attitude. This role requires the ability to work efficiently under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously, often with shifting deadlines. Strong interpersonal skills are essential as more than half of this coordinator’s communication will be with external partners, so excellent written and verbal communication skills are a must. Experience disseminating and following up on critical communications with external partners is highly valued.


**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**


**IP \& Asset Governance**


* Coordinate the approval process governing creative assets and campaign materials across internal teams and IP owners.
* Ensure IP usage requirements are followed by internal teams.
* Maintain and update IP usage ‘bibles,’ ensuring changes to rights usage are properly documented and distributed to appropriate stakeholders.


**Campaign Planning \& Execution**


* Support the execution of client brand campaigns, multi\-title initiatives, and tentpole marketing programs.
* Maintain campaign calendars, workbacks, trackers, and status documents.
* Ensure partner approved assets and key IP usage information is organized and distributed to appropriate internal and external stakeholders.


**Cross\-Functional Coordination**


* Partner with teams across Creative, Social, Communications, Lifecycle, Programming, and Production to support campaign initiatives.
* Schedule meetings and coordinate logistics for team and cross\-functional discussions.
* Capture meeting notes, document action items, and track follow\-ups across stakeholder groups.
* Maintain clear communication across teams to ensure all tasks related to approvals and IP usage remain organized and on schedule.


**Project Management \& Operations**


* Maintain key documents, calendars, trackers, presentations, and status reports related to external partner management.
* Assist with the organization and management of shared marketing resources, reference materials, and project documentation.
* Support the development of presentations, planning documents, executive updates, and campaign recaps.
* Maintain team files, archives, and shared drives to ensure materials are easily accessible.
* Provide administrative and operational support to the client Partnership \& Brand Marketing team as needed.


**Research \& Performance Analysis**


* Assist in gathering campaign performance data and key insights from cross\-functional teams.
* Support the development of campaign recaps and post\-campaign analyses, documenting learnings and recommendations.
* Stay informed on entertainment, streaming, media, and consumer trends to help identify opportunities for innovation and growth.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


**Required**


* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 1–2\+ years of experience in marketing, entertainment, media, advertising, or a related field, including internships and coordinator\-level roles.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Exceptional attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to learn.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications, including PowerPoint, Excel, Google Slides, and Google Sheets


**Preferred**


* Experience working with marketing legal teams.
* Background in entertainment, streaming, media, advertising, or consumer brands.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Airtable, Monday.com, Asana, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with AI tools like Claude or Gemini, and open to learning how to incorporate into work flows to increase efficiency
* Spanish language proficiency and/or interest in US Hispanic marketing campaigns a plus.
* Interest in anime, sports, and kids programming.

  

**Skills** **Mandatory Skills :** Content Workflow Management, E2E Media Supply Chain

jobs.title: Sales Operations & Business Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Sales Operations \& Business Development Coordinator (Travel/Remote)** **Sullivan on Comp** is a subscription\-based legal research and technology platform serving the California workers’ compensation industry. The sales team is also expanding its business\-development efforts for Cadence, an AI platform used by law firms and claims organizations to review and analyze workers’ compensation matters.  

Sullivan on Comp is seeking a proactive, highly organized **Sales Operations \& Business Development Coordinator** to provide direct support to the Account Executive responsible for new\-business development. The primary focus of this role is to support revenue\-generating sales activity. Pipeline prioritization, prospect follow\-up, trial engagement, re\-engagement, and business\-development support will take precedence over routine CRM cleanup and administrative tasks when priorities compete.  

This position combines HubSpot and pipeline management with prospect research, trial engagement, outbound follow\-up, sales campaigns, and business\-development support.
The successful candidate will help ensure that promising opportunities receive consistent attention, stale opportunities are identified and appropriately re\-engaged, and the Account Executive can spend more time on substantive sales conversations, demonstrations, relationship development, and closing. **Compensation:**  

* $32 – $38/hour ($66,560 – $79,040 annually)
* Annual performance incentive of 5% target / 7\.5% maximum
 **Travel \& Work Location**  

* Candidate must reside in CA.
* This position can be performed primarily in a remote environment, with up to 15% \- 25% travel.
* Travel may include but is not limited to 2\-3 meetings in SoCal Office, approximately 10 industry conferences or trade shows each lasting 2\-4 days, and additional occasional business travel on an as\-needed basis.

 **Daily Objectives**  

* Manage and prioritize the HubSpot sales pipeline, ensuring accurate deal, activity, forecast, and next\-step data while identifying high\-priority opportunities for Account Executive focus.
* Monitor active trials and prospect engagement, conduct outreach via phone and email, gather feedback, and schedule demonstrations, training sessions, and follow\-up meetings.
* Research target organizations, decision\-makers, and market opportunities within the California workers’ compensation industry using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other business intelligence tools.
* Re\-engage dormant leads, inactive opportunities, former customers, and trial users through targeted email, phone, and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.
* Support outbound business development efforts by booking qualified meetings and advancing prospects toward substantive sales conversations.
* Assist with HubSpot sequences, workflows, lead segmentation, webinars, re\-engagement initiatives, and targeted marketing campaigns while monitoring campaign performance.
* Leverage sales intelligence and CRM data to identify follow\-up priorities, uncover growth opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to improve pipeline progression.
* Maintain detailed records of sales activities, prepare meeting briefings, track follow\-up commitments, coordinate proposals, and support accurate forecasting and reporting.
* Collaborate with Account Management, Marketing, Customer Service, and other internal teams to support customer acquisition and revenue growth initiatives.
* Support industry conferences, trade shows, and firm events through planning, on\-site participation, lead capture, post\-event follow\-up, and business travel as needed.
 **Skills \& Experience**  

* 2\+ years of experience in sales and/or business development in the Workers’ Compensation, Insurance, Legal Tech, SAAS, or similar Legal Services industry.
* Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM.
* Experience providing client activation and renewal support to account management, sales, or customer success teams.
* Strong organizational skills, highly detail\-oriented, excellent time management, and holding strong follow\-through abilities.
* Strong multi\-tasking abilities, ability to work independently, and proactively work as part of a team.
* Be comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, databases, and sales systems.
* Strong customer service and ability to communicate professionally on the phone and via email.
* Exercise good judgment regarding when an issue should be escalated.
* Be willing and able to travel for conferences, trade shows, and firm meetings.

 **Health \& Wellness**  

* Medical plan options including **Kaiser Permanente** HMO, **Cigna** EPO, and **Cigna** PPO
* Dental coverage through **Delta Dental** with DHMO and PPO options
* **Vision** coverage through VSP
* Firm\-Paid **Life/AD\&D** (up to $150k) \& Long\-term Disability (**LTD**) Insurance.
* Firm\-Paid Employee Assistance Program (**EAP**) offering confidential support.
 **Retirement \& Voluntary Benefits*** **401(k)** retirement plan with employer contribution.
* **Critical Illness**, **Accident**, and **Hospital Indemnity Coverage**, available at group rates.
* Flexible Spending Account (**FSA**) and Dependent Care Assistance Program (**DCAP**) options for eligible pre\-tax expenses.
* Voluntary short\-term disability (**STD**) coverage.
* Supplemental **Life and AD\&D Insurance**.
* Optional **Pet Insurance**, because family comes in many forms.
 *Sullivan on Comp provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic makeup, marital status, military service, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.*

jobs.title: Service Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and customer\-focused Service Account Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will develop and maintain positive relationships within assigned customer accounts, overseeing the sales process, and acting as the primary point of contact to retain and grow these accounts. You will maintain regular communication with customers, coordinate with the Service team to ensure satisfaction, promptly address concerns and advocate for customers when performance or billing issues arise. Assigned accounts are generally larger and more complex.


**Position Details**


* Primarily responsible for growing our overall service business by prospecting in assigned market territory to develop and cultivate new “existing building” “owner direct” customers.
* Primary goal is to sell new service maintenance agreements and truck\-based service and project work.
* Proactively manages the service sales process to close sales, including prospecting, qualifying, customer’s setup and procurement process, proposals, presentations, as well as handling questions and objections.
* Develops and maintains positive relationships within assigned customer accounts. Oversees the sales process and acts as a “One Southland” point of contact for customers, engaging any internal teams or support necessary to allow for additional business development.
* Continuously generates new sales by using existing and potential customer networks and social networking. Identifies new business opportunities acting as the customer’s building solutions partner for all areas of locally provided service offerings.
* Mentors less\-experienced Service Account Managers.


**Qualifications**


* Two\-year relevant degree or equivalent training and experience, such as trade\-level training or industry experience
* 3\+ years in direct relevant experience
* Strong knowledge of service policies, procedures and capabilities
* Strong verbal and written communication, including presentation skills
* Strong customer service skills and ability to develop customer relationships
* Demonstrated sales skills in prospecting, qualifying, proposing and closing sales and capable of developing and managing large accounts (existing and new)
* Strong collaboration skills internally and externally, with strong problem\-solving abilities
* Frequent travel to job sites within assigned region
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Solid knowledge of CRM


**Benefits**

As a 100% employee\-owned company, we offer a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family:


* 401(k) plan with **50% company match (no cap)** and immediate 100% vesting
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance **(100% paid for employee)**
* Annual bonus program based upon performance, achievement, and company profitability
* Term life, AD\&D insurance, and voluntary life insurance
* Disability income protection insurance
* Pre\-tax flexible spending plans (health and dependent care)
* **Paid parental leave**
* Paid holidays, vacation, and personal time
* Training/professional development opportunities and company\-paid memberships for professional associations and licenses
* Wellness benefits


**About Southland Industries**

As one of the nation’s largest MEP companies, Southland Industries is built on the foundation of great people. Since 1949, we have put our people first, enabling growth, professional achievement, and innovation. If you want to join a fast\-paced environment where you’re engaged, challenged, and valued, apply now to join our dynamic team.


To learn more about careers at Southland, explore our career opportunities, follow us on social media, and check out our website.

  




Southland Industries and all its subsidiaries are an **Equal Opportunity Employer**and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing our employees with a safe work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Southland Industries are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, gender, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, family care or medical leave status, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Southland Industries will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

  




**Pay:** Final pay is determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data. For California this ranges from $90,781\.00 \- $116,719\.00 plus annual incentive, benefits, and retirement program as outlined above.

  




**Contingent Employment:** All employment offers are contingent upon successful drug tests, background checks, and professional reference checks. Roles that include driving as an essential job duty will be required to have a successful Motor Vehicle Record check (MVR). We are not able to offer sponsorship of employment at this time.

Candidate ownership can only be established after a bona fide work order is issued by a member of the Southland Industries Talent Acquisition team and the candidate is appropriately submitted through our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager-SGWS West Admin
jobs.description:
The Wine Group (TWG) is a leading producer of award\-winning wines and alcoholic beverages across 120\+ brands. With operations in California, New York and Australia, TWG is an innovator in developing and marketing brands beloved by consumers globally, including Cupcake, Franzia, Benziger, Imagery, Tribute, Chloe, Meiomi, Cooks, 7 Deadly, Cooper \& Thief, and more. We produce our products using sustainable practices to create delicious beverages that people can feel good about. Visit us at www.thewinegroup.com.
  
  

JOB SUMMARY
  
  

The Regional Account Manager – Western Region is responsible for executing TWG’s National Account Strategy across the entire TWG portfolio within both independent liquor accounts and regional grocery / convenience/ small format accounts. This role will partner with the TWG Field Sales Organization (FSO) to optimize program execution with wholesalers. They will develop and implement annual strategic plans to expand TWG’s presence within each retail chain and establish measurable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that drive brand growth. Additionally, they will ensure execution levels align with TWG’s Annual Operating Plan (AOP), delivering strong results and positioning TWG for continued success in the region. The ideal candidate will live in the Southern California area.
  
  

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  
  

* Develop, lead, and ensure execution of TWG’s strategy related to our agreed AOP plan for Regional Account Universe
* Responsible for delivering Region Account AOP Plan, Scorecard objectives and KPI’s.
* Build relationships with regional chain buyers and all key decision makers in each account. Build quality relationships with Director/VP of Regional Chains at wholesaler as well as the KAMs and Execution teams.
* Understand TWG new item initiatives and how to prioritize them for each customer based on their individual go\-to\-market strategy.
* Translate national strategy into localized execution plans, tailored to their retailers.
* Conduct monthly program presentations against TWG priorities and chain specific opportunities; maximize TWG share of merchandising activity.
* Create and sell high impact Trade Marketing programs.
* Supports Field Sales to maximize program execution through all key phases: Planning\-Communication\-Execution\-Evaluation.
* Manage budgets in the following categories: Pricing, Incentives, Coupons, Demos and Tasting, Travel and Entertainment expenses.
* Handle administration as required by each chain and TWG.
* This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* BA degree or equivalent experience and proficient skills in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Preferred 5 or more years of sales experience in the alcoholic beverage industry or related business with knowledge and passion for both commercial and premium wines.
* Must have strong understanding and working knowledge of alcoholic beverage industry retail environment.
* Intermediate wine knowledge or associated certifications preferred.
* Must be well organized with an ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment and be adaptive to change within organization and industry.
* Results oriented, innovation, strong problem solving and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work and succeed in dynamic entrepreneurial environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willing to travel with overnight stays as needed.
* Display integrity, character, and strong leadership skills.
* Support and model all company procedures and policies.
* Ability to multi\-task, work independently and with a team in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment with emphasis on accuracy and timeliness.
* Must have excellent safety, work performance, and attendance record.
* Prioritize while able to adapt to changing priorities.
* Demonstrated reliability and punctuality, work effectively in team/crew environment, adherence to all safety regulations and operating procedures.
* Embrace and demonstrate The Wine Group Core Values – Performance, Empowerment, and Cost\-Mindful, and utilize them for all decision making.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS
  
  

* Ability to perform tasks requiring bending, stooping, standing, and twisting in the performance of various tasks.
* Able to lift and carry up to 50 pounds at varying frequencies.
* Ability to travel frequently between home office, client sites, and industry meetings/events.


COMPENSATION
  
  

* Hiring Salary Range Posted: $120,100 \- $150,000\.
* Actual compensation will be based on factors such as experience, skills, knowledge, and abilities, education, and other position\-related factors.


At The Wine Group, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristic protected by law.
  
  

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES
  
  

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Recruitment Services Agreement, we will not consider, or agree to, payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event that a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency.

Field Sales Representatives at AT\&T are driven to connect – every interaction is an opportunity to introduce the latest technology and services, thriving on the challenge to make your sales goals happen. With uncapped commission potential, your career and the rewards that come with it are within reach. Enjoy uncapped commission potential as a Field Sales Representative, with top earners having the opportunity to make $100,000\.


Our new Field Sales Representatives earn between $62,900 to $100,000, including the salary and our uncapped commission opportunities. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training. Salary range is dependent on if all sales goals are met and/or exceeded.


You’ll be the face and voice of AT\&T to your customers, working independently to deliver personalized sales interactions at scheduled appointments provided to you. You’ll close the deal by offering hands\-on demos, Wi\-Fi assessments, tech delivery and issue resolutions \- keeping customers connected to what matters most to them.

* We’ll kick things off with paid training –setting you up for success to work independently in the field. Coaching, mentoring and ongoing learning opportunities will keep you on track and tech\-savvy
* You’ll connect with our existing customers daily. AT\&T will provide scheduled appointments, giving you the opportunity to engage with warm prospects effectively.
* You’ll use strong negotiation and communications skills – you know how to make a smooth pivot, and are highly motivated to get it right and make the sale

**Key expectations to succeed:**

* **1\+ years of commission sales and outside sales experience highly preferred**
* Demonstrated success in commission sales and achieving sales targets
* Proficient in upselling techniques that enhance customer value and satisfaction
* Strong verbal communication skills with an ability to build rapport quickly
* Maintain a valid driver’s license—be ready to drive, as we provide a company vehicle for **official business use only**
* Work a varied schedule designed to meet customers on their timeline –this includes evenings, weekends, and holidays
* Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, including drug screening, criminal history, and motor vehicle record


If you are considering jobs like Direct Sales Representative, Residential Sales Representative, Territory Sales Representative or Field Sales Executive – Home Solutions, this career move would be a great fit!

**Joining our team comes with amazing perks and benefits:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Tuition reimbursement program

* Adoption Reimbursement

* A company paid device and service plan, giving you first\-hand expertise with our latest technology.


Ready to take your career on a new route? Apply today.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, trends\-obsessed, and visually sharp **Social Media Specialist** to lead and elevate our social media presence across both our in\-house brand and client projects.

In this role, you won’t just post content—you will conceive, create, and execute original, highly engaging campaigns that captivate audiences. If you know how to turn viral trends into on\-brand moments, have an impeccable aesthetic eye, and speak the language of every major platform (from TikTok to RedNote), we want you on our team!

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* **Content Strategy \& Execution:** Plan, create, and manage the end\-to\-end social media content calendar for both our in\-house brand and client accounts.
* **Creative Idea Generation:** Brainstorm out\-of\-the\-box, funny, and engaging content concepts (reels, shorts, carousels, memes) that align with brand identities and captivate modern audiences.
* **Visual \& Aesthetic Management:** Oversee visual direction—ensuring all photos, short\-form videos, graphics, and layout aesthetics are consistently on\-trend, polished, and on\-brand.
* **Platform Mastery:** Adapt tone, formatting, and strategies specifically for Instagram, TikTok, RedNote, and YouTube (Shorts/Long\-form).
* **Community Engagement:** Foster active online communities by engaging with comments, messages, and audience interactions with a distinct brand voice.
* **Trend \& Algorithm Spotting:** Stay ahead of internet culture, platform updates, audio trends, and viral formats to quickly produce real\-time, relevant content.
* **Performance Tracking:** Analyze social media metrics (reach, engagement, conversion) using platform analytics tools to optimize future content strategies.

**Qualifications**

* Strong sense of visual storytelling, graphic design aesthetic, and basic photo/video editing skills (CapCut, Canva, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, or Lightroom).
* Exceptional story\-telling skills with a knack for humor, pop culture references, and unique angles that break through feed noise.
* Excellent Communication skills, including clear written communication, collaboration with cross\-functional teams, and professional engagement with online communities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced on\-site environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proactive, highly organized, and able to jump on real\-time trends quickly.
* Engage with followers through comments, messages, and community interactions to foster strong relationships.
* Analyze digital marketing performance data regularly to assess campaign effectiveness and recommend improvements for future initiatives.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in social media marketing or digital marketing roles with a focus on content creation, campaign management, and analytics interpretation.
* Strong proficiency in social media management tools such as Hootsuite or Buffer.
* Skilled in graphic design using Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, or similar media editing tools.
* Knowledge of SEO principles, keyword research techniques, and web analytics platforms like Google Analytics.
* Experience managing paid advertising campaigns on Facebook Ads Manager or similar platforms.
* Excellent written communication skills with an eye for proofreading and content writing accuracy.
* Ability to analyze media performance metrics to inform strategic decisions effectively.
* Familiarity with public relations practices and relationship management within digital spaces is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.

Sales Development Representative  


Unite Health Share Ministries (UHSM) is a nonprofit, faith\-based health sharing ministry that facilitates member\-to\-member health sharing among fellow Christians, serving as a connector to administer medical cost sharing. The UHSM mission is to help Christian families fulfill their God\-given purpose to care for one another and to positively impact our communities. Headquartered in Norfolk, VA, UHSM takes a modern approach to health sharing that prioritizes holistic health and wellbeing. UHSM offers simple, fair, and friendly health share programs to its members.  


About this role  


Are you a dynamic and ambitious Sales Development Representative with a passion for expanding customer bases and generating qualified sales opportunities? If so, we want you on board to help UHSM revolutionize the healthcare industry! As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our Team Development Leader and take ownership of engaging prospective individuals and families, paving the way for our Account Executive team to close deals. Join us in our mission to provide customizable healthcare solutions that help individuals and businesses reduce costs, protect their assets, manage risks, and achieve financial success.  


On\-site: This is a full\-time, in\-office position at our Santa Ana, CA location.  


Key Responsibilities  


Learn \& become an expert on UHSM’s product offerings.  
Leverage opportunities to learn the market and business.  
Contact leads via phone, auto\-dialer, email, and/or web chat to qualify prospects and promote UHSM product offerings and services.  
Answer inbound direct calls from prospective new members to pre\-qualify and provide opportunities for the Account Executive team.  
Work with team members to meet conversion, acquisition, and revenue goals.

Meet or exceed projected weekly and monthly performance targets.

Accurately document the customer's personal information including phone number, address, and other order information.  
Persuasively engage the customer in conversation to explain how UHSM products and/or services will add value to their lives and meet their needs.  
Ask relevant leading questions to understand the customer's needs.  
Follow prepared scripts to provide accurate and compliant information.  
Contribute to overall team success \- relay any information that may be of value to the team such as best practices, market sentiment, competitive pressures, etc.  


Required Qualifications  


1\+ years of customer service, sales, or sales development experience.  
1\+ years of experience with CRM or sales enablement software.  
Able to work in our Santa Ana, CA office location.  


Preferred Qualifications  


Bachelor’s degree  
Healthcare sales experience.  
Strong technical aptitude.  
Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving ability.  
Creativity, curiosity, and desire to find “the third alternative” when faced with a challenge.  
Strong organizational skills.  
Desire to make an impact at a disruptive technology company.  
Excellent interpersonal oral and written communication skills.  
Avid learner – our company is always evolving, and your knowledge must evolve too!  
Able to accept constructive criticism and continually improve sales techniques.  
Experience in a position where meeting sales goals was an important indication of performance.  
Eagerness to grow.  


What we offer  


Competitive Hourly \+ Bonus  
Health, Dental, Vision, and 403(b) with company match.  
Ability to make important enhancements to the Healthcare industry.  
Great culture where you work with the founders and key stakeholders in a relaxed, but innovative atmosphere.  


UHSM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our business is fast\-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business needs. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.description:
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**Reporting to the Clinical Research Supervisor, Clinical Research Manager, or Director of Clinical Research Operations, the Clinical Research Coordinator II (CRC\-II) is responsible for all aspects of clinical research activities and works in close cooperation with study physicians, inter\- and intradepartmental stakeholders, and sponsors. The CRC\-II provides study management, support, and coordination for FDA regulated research industry\-sponsored, government funded, and/or investigator initiated clinical research trials. This may include blood collection, data and trials that have therapeutic or device component. The CRC\-II ensures smooth, accurate process of clinical studies from the planning, implementation, and post\-study closure procedures.


The CRC\-II is involved in all aspects of the clinical research process included, but no limited to protocol review, preparation and administration of the informed consent, development of study treatment plans, completion of study related visit forms, ensuring protocol required assessments are completed per study guidelines, processing of lab samples per IATA standards, and regular communication with study sponsors and their collaborators.


He/she will ensure accurate completion of case report forms (CRFs), adverse event/serious adverse event (SAE) reporting and scheduled subject follow\-up visits. Discusses research study with potential study subjects and answers any questions (may refer questions to Principal Investigator or Sub\-Investigator when appropriate) while obtaining informed consent.


Responsible for development of study flow sheets, prepare study source documentation, gather study data, and assess subject for study eligibility (inclusion/exclusion). In addition, the CRC\-II will record protocol specific assessments and treatments, ensure collection and shipment of samples, complete study forms to submit to sponsors and/or appropriate agencies, collect, enters and clean data into study database while maintaining data quality. I. He/she will host study team meetings, attend site initiation visits (SIVs) and perform other duties as assigned.


Must be knowledgeable of Good Clinical Practices, protection of human subjects in research practices, and FDA regulatory guidelines regarding clinical research.


  
**Education and Experience*** High School Diploma with 2\-3 years of Clinical Research Coordinator experience and demonstrated skills to successfully perform the assigned duties and responsibilities; and/or equivalent experience/training.
* Excellent verbal and written communications and presentation skills; excellent organizational skills; and excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse team.
* Attention to details.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Windows.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects.
* Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co\-workers, \& physicians.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Medical terminology required. Working knowledge of FDA, NIH and OHRP regulatory requirements and ICH GCP guidelines.
* Understanding of clinical trial methodologies and experience filing Institutional Review Board documents.
* Ability to abstract data from medical records and transfer it to data collection forms or directly into databases.
* International Air Transport Association (IATA) Certification
* Current ACRP or SoCRA Certification.

**License Required:**N/A


**License Preferred:**N/A


**Certifications Required**N/A


**Certifications Preferred**May only perform blood draws by meeting and maintaining State of California Certified Phlebotomy Technician I (CPTI) Certification

Glovis America makes every effort to exceed standards by providing quality service to our customers and vendors of the automotive, freight forwarding, parts distribution, used car, and fuel industries. We cater logistics strategies and processes to our customers' needs by utilizing the latest information systems and advanced technologies.
  
Summary
  
The Executive Assistant is responsible for supporting executive leadership through business reporting, executive communications, meeting and travel coordination, and strategic information management. The role prepares executive\-level reporting materials, coordinates leadership meetings and business activities, manages executive administrative processes, and supports organizational reporting and communication initiatives. Success in this role requires expertise in executive reporting, calendar and meeting coordination, business communications, presentation development, attention to detail, and stakeholder management.

$58,000 \- $64,000 yearly salary range. (Subject to Compensation Study Upon Candidate Selection)

* Coordinate CEO and COO calendars, meetings, appointments, and business travel schedules to support executive priorities and organizational objectives.
* Compile, review, and prepare meeting materials, briefing documents, presentations, and supporting information for CEO and COO meetings.

**Job Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM

**Work Location:** In person

**About TACLAB**

TACLAB is a fast\-growing U.S.\-based e\-commerce company headquartered in Irvine, California.

Over the past three years, our business has grown rapidly, expanding by more than 100 times in scale. Today, TACLAB has grown into a team of approximately 8–10 employees, with continued expansion across e\-commerce, product development, wholesale, and international markets.

As the company continues to grow, the CEO’s daily responsibilities and business activities have become increasingly busy and complex. We are looking for a highly organized, responsible, and capable **Executive Assistant** to work closely with the CEO and support a wide range of business, operational, administrative, and coordination tasks.

**Position Overview**

This position will work directly with the CEO and assist with day\-to\-day business management and execution.

The role combines executive support, document preparation, task tracking, external business coordination, inventory and logistics support, recruiting coordination, and other company\-related responsibilities assigned by the CEO.

We are looking for someone who is organized, detail\-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple tasks while ensuring important matters are followed up on and completed on time.

**Fluent Chinese and English communication skills are required.**

**Key Responsibilities**

Please note that the responsibilities listed below represent the overall scope of this position and are not necessarily daily recurring tasks. Duties such as inventory management, recruiting, purchase order coordination, factory communication, and logistics support will be handled as business needs arise and as assigned by the CEO.

**1\. Executive Documents \& Administrative Support**

* Assist the CEO with preparation, review, organization, and management of business documents.
* Draft and organize professional emails, reports, summaries, internal documents, correspondence, and other written materials.
* Assist with research, information gathering, and preparation of reference materials.
* Use AI\-assisted and other productivity tools to improve efficiency in document preparation, research, and information organization.
* Maintain and organize company and customer\-related files, records, and business documents.
* Assist with printing, preparing, organizing, and maintaining customer and company materials.
* Support customer relationship maintenance and follow\-up when requested.
* Help ensure important documents and information are properly organized and easily accessible.

**2\. CEO Task Management \& Follow\-Up**

* Assist the CEO with various daily business matters and company\-related tasks.
* Create and maintain task lists, schedules, deadlines, and follow\-up timelines.
* Track ongoing tasks and projects and proactively remind the CEO of important deadlines, pending decisions, and required actions.
* Follow up with internal employees, vendors, factories, customers, or external partners when needed.
* Help prevent important matters from being delayed, forgotten, or becoming overdue.
* Organize information that requires the CEO’s review, approval, confirmation, or decision.
* Help prioritize urgent and time\-sensitive matters.
* Continue following up on assigned tasks until they are fully completed.

**3\. Factory \& Purchase Order Coordination**

* Serve as a communication and coordination point between TACLAB and overseas manufacturing factories.
* Prepare and place purchase orders based on company instructions.
* Follow up with factories regarding production schedules, quantities, order status, and delivery dates.
* Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, production progress, and expected delivery timelines.
* Identify possible production delays and report them to the CEO in advance.
* Follow up with factories until orders are completed and shipped.
* Assist with product replenishment planning based on company inventory needs.

**4\. Inventory Management**

* Monitor product inventory levels and maintain accurate inventory records.
* Review current inventory, incoming inventory, sales demand, and outstanding purchase orders.
* Help ensure sufficient inventory is available to support company operations and sales.
* Identify products, colors, or sizes that may be running low and notify the CEO or relevant team members in advance.
* Assist with replenishment planning and purchase order coordination.
* Help reduce the risk of stockouts, overselling, and inventory shortages.
* Maintain visibility into available, incoming, and committed inventory.

**5\. Logistics \& External Business Coordination**

* Communicate with freight forwarders, logistics companies, customs\-related service providers, and other external vendors.
* Coordinate shipment arrangements between overseas factories, logistics providers, and the U.S. warehouse.
* Review factory delivery dates and customer order commitments to help determine appropriate shipping arrangements.
* Assist the CEO in determining whether shipments should be sent by air, ocean, or other transportation methods based on timing and urgency.
* Review and confirm shipment information, product quantities, transportation arrangements, and related charges.
* Track shipments from factory departure through transportation, customs clearance, and warehouse delivery.
* Identify potential shipping delays and report time\-sensitive issues before they impact customer fulfillment.

**6\. Recruiting Coordination**

As the company continues to grow, this position will also assist with recruiting needs across different departments when required.

Responsibilities may include:

* Posting job openings on recruiting platforms.
* Reviewing and screening resumes and applications.
* Identifying candidates who meet basic job requirements.

**About BRAVAS**


At BRAVAS, we transform homes into extraordinary living experiences. As the nation’s \#1 luxury technology integrator, we design and deliver premium solutions \- lighting, shades, A/V, networking, home automation, and more, that make life effortless, beautiful, and connected.


We partner with homeowners, architects, builders, and designers on some of the most spectacular homes in the country. And we’re growing.

**The Role**


The Project Coordinator \& Scheduler sits at the center of project execution, supporting Project Managers, coordinating technician schedules across multiple concurrent jobs, and serving as the communication link between clients, field teams, and internal departments. This role is equal parts logistics, coordination, and follow\-through, and embodies our six core values: collaborative, accountable, proactive, curious, passionate, and creative.

**Responsibilities**

* Supports Project Managers with day\-to\-day project activities, documentation, change orders, and milestone tracking.
* Builds and manages installation and technician schedules across multiple projects, assigning resources based on scope, location, and skillset.
* Monitors resource availability and adjusts schedules proactively in response to delays, scope changes, or conflicts.
* Coordinates with warehouse and logistics teams to align technician schedules with material delivery timelines.
* Tracks procurement and ensures timely delivery of equipment and materials to job sites.

* Experience in project coordination, scheduling, or operations; construction, technology, or field services a plus.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
### **About NeuroSpark**


NeuroSpark builds and operates a high\-performance AI inference platform that helps enterprises run large language models faster, cheaper, and at scale. Inference infrastructure is the foundation the entire AI application layer runs on — every AI product ultimately depends on how fast, how reliably, and how affordably models can serve their users. Our vision is to make that layer so efficient that compute is never the reason a good AI product fails.### **About the Role**


NeuroSpark Inc operates an enterprise AI inference platform serving customers with production AI workloads. As an Account Manager, you will own the ongoing customer relationship, monitor account health and usage, manage the customer onboarding pipeline, and identify opportunities to expand customer adoption and revenue.


This is a customer\-facing commercial role with direct responsibility for retention, upsell, and revenue growth. You will work closely with Customer Engineering, Engineering, Operations, and company leadership to ensure customers are successfully onboarded, supported, and growing on the NeuroSpark platform.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own day\-to\-day relationships with a portfolio of customer accounts and serve as the primary commercial point of contact.
* Monitor customer health, platform usage, engagement, open issues, and upcoming needs to identify risks and opportunities early.
* Own and maintain visibility into the customer onboarding pipeline, coordinating internal stakeholders to keep implementations and launches moving forward.
* Drive customer adoption and identify upsell and expansion opportunities based on usage growth, new workloads, additional models, capacity needs, or broader platform adoption.
* Contribute directly to revenue targets through account retention, expansion, and commercial follow\-through.
* Develop trusted relationships across customer engineering, product, operations, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders.
* Partner with Customer Engineering and Engineering to ensure technical issues, capacity requirements, and customer priorities are addressed effectively.
* Lead regular customer check\-ins, account reviews, and internal updates on account status, risks, growth opportunities, and next actions.
* Support pricing, renewal, upsell, contract, billing, and procurement discussions in coordination with company leadership and Operations.
* Collect structured customer feedback and communicate recurring market needs to Product and Engineering.
* Help build repeatable account\-management and customer\-monitoring processes as NeuroSpark's customer base grows.

### **Qualifications**

* Experience in Account Management, Customer Success, enterprise sales, business development, partnerships, or another customer\-facing commercial role.
* Demonstrated ability to manage ongoing customer relationships and drive customer retention, expansion, or revenue growth.
* Strong commercial judgment and comfort discussing customer priorities, usage, pricing, renewals, and upsell opportunities.
* Ability to understand a technical product well enough to communicate credibly with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple accounts, onboarding workstreams, and internal follow\-ups simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong executive presence and attention to detail.
* High ownership, responsiveness, and ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience at an AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, developer\-tools, or enterprise technology company.
* Experience managing usage\-based or consumption\-based customer accounts.
* Experience owning revenue, renewal, expansion, or upsell targets.
* Familiarity with AI inference, APIs, cloud infrastructure, GPUs, or developer\-facing technical products.
* Experience working with startup and enterprise customers across both technical and business stakeholders.

### **What Success Looks Like**

**Position Summary:** Mirapath is looking for a goal\-oriented Territory Account Manager to cultivate and expand our footprint in the South Central territory. This role focuses on acquiring new business logos, generating a robust sales pipeline, fostering connections with potential clients, and growing strategic current accounts.


The ideal candidate will have existing industry ties in AI infrastructure, data centers, enterprise IT, colocation, or critical facilities, along with a history of sourcing and securing new ventures independently. This is a field\-based remote role.

**Position Responsibilities**
=============================

**Sales \& Revenue Growth**
===========================

* **Own new\-logo acquisition and revenue growth across the assigned territory.**
* Develop and execute a territory plan that identifies priority markets, target accounts, key stakeholders, partner relationships, and near\-term opportunities.
* Build and maintain a self\-generated pipeline through existing relationships, direct prospecting, referrals, industry associations, manufacturer and partner networks, events, phone, email, LinkedIn, and coordinated marketing activities.

* Recommend new products and services by evaluating current product results and identifying needs to be filled

* Participate in team meetings and take responsibility for sales improvement initiatives

**Client Relationship Management**
----------------------------------

* **Build and maintain strong client relationships**
* Manage and resolve client concerns/issues during the entire sales cycle
* Provide product and pricing information by clarifying customer requests, selecting appropriate information, and answering questions
* Develop multithreaded relationships with data center, IT, network, facilities, engineering, procurement, operations, and executive stakeholders.
* Provide quality customer service in assisting customers on questions and/or requests
* Represent Mirapath at customer meetings, industry events, partner engagements, and regional networking opportunities.
* Explain the scope of all solutions and position them in relation to an organization's requirements

**Cross\-Functional and Internal Collaboration**
------------------------------------------------

* **Communicate, liaise, and negotiate internally and externally to facilitate the development of profitable business and sustainable relationships**
* Lead the complete sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through solution development, proposal, negotiation, closing, and post\-sale account expansion.
* Keep management informed by submitting activity and results reports
* Develop and tailor materials to assist the sales team in explaining key features \& benefits
* Work collaboratively and productively with other departments to meet customer needs
* Create processes that improve efficiencies and gather consensus and buy\-in from those involved

**Additional Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* **Maintain all aspects of client records, including meeting notes and activities, in CRM database**
* Provide regular territory forecasts, pipeline updates, competitive intelligence, and account\-development plans to sales leadership.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of Mirapath's product set; participate in educational opportunities
* Attend internal meetings, exhibitions, and events as required
* Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed




**Position Requirements**


* BA/BS in a business or technical related field or equivalent combination of education and experience required. MBA a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience selling relevant and related products; experience with data center/IT infrastructure products.
* Proficient computer, software, and data analysis skills (Netsuite/ERP, Salesforce.com/CRM, Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
* Demonstrate strong initiative, resiliency, organizational and time management skills
* Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Excellent problem solver with strong negotiation and presentation skills
* Proven record in business development and account planning/management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Resourceful and ability to adapt quickly to changing environment
* Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage time within a fast\-paced environment
* Travel up to 25% of the time

jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------



**Grow with us!**  

HCI Systems, Inc. is seeking a results\-driven, enthusiastic sales professional to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will sell enterprise\-level integrated security solutions with a focus on new construction and build strong relationships with end\-users, electrical contractors and general contractors. You will have the opportunity to prospect and cultivate new relationships, gain an understanding of our clients' needs, and secure sales opportunities.  

**About Us:** HCI Systems, Inc. is a renowned leader in the fire life safety and low voltage industry, providing our clients with an end\-to\-end service offering that allows them to bundle all their needs under one provider.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Drive business growth by prospecting and cultivating new relationships and identifying and educating prospective customers about HCI's products and services.
* Be responsible for identifying customer needs and developing strategies to meet company sales objectives.
* Lead the sales process from proposal development to closing, including crafting comprehensive scopes of work, managing project scope communication, and handling change order costs.
* Serve as the primary contact for clients, ensuring strong partnerships are established and maintained before, during, and after the sales process. Oversee all aspects of customer accounts, including managing active accounts and fostering sales growth.
* Collaborate with premier partners in vertical markets, such as transportation, global/enterprise accounts, utilities, financial/banking, healthcare, datacenters, federal, state, and local governments, and K\-12 \& higher education.
* Develop business opportunities by conducting needs assessments and constructing winning proposals for system installation and service opportunities.
* Develop financial justifications, perform takeoffs, prepare estimates and proposals, make presentations, and perform the necessary follow\-up for a successful closing of the sale.
* Build market awareness through networking, presentations, event attendance, and industry associations.
* Partner with operations personnel to execute growth, development, sales, and marketing strategies.
* Achieve agreed upon sales targets and outcomes within schedule.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* Associate degree or equivalent experience required; Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or engineering preferred.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of demonstrated successful sales in the security integration industry, general construction, or electrical construction industry.
* Comprehensive industry knowledge of security integration solutions and/or other related low voltage systems.
* Ability to quickly identify and qualify opportunities, as well as handle complex, large\-scale accounts and high\-value contracts.
* Experience working with electrical contractors, general contractors, consultants, engineers or end users, with the ability to read construction blueprints and wiring diagrams.
* High degree of self\-discipline and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced corporate environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, using tact and diplomacy when dealing with customers.
* Must be reliable, self\-motivated, success\-driven, with excellent organizational, negotiating and follow\-up skills.
* Proficiency in industry\-related equipment including Windows, MS Office, and customer relationship management (CRM) software.
* Applicants must meet requirements in relation to background, have a valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.
* Regular, reliable, predictable attendance.

***\*\*compensation range includes potential commissions earned on sales\*\****  

HCI Systems Inc. is a licensed C\-7, C\-10 and C\-16 low voltage systems integration contractor offering a full spectrum of services including sales, engineering, installation, service, and maintenance with over 600 employees in our seven branches. We offer fire life safety, fire suppression, fire sprinkler, access control, video management, intrusion detection, structured cable, nurse call and other related electronic detection solutions to our customers.  

**Why Join Us?**
* **Unlimited Growth** – Our expanding product lines and markets drive consistent double\-digit growth, creating ongoing opportunities for advancement.
* **Comprehensive Benefits** – Enjoy 401(k) with matching, reduced\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible spending accounts. Additional voluntary benefits include life insurance, disability, and accident coverage.

* **Weekly Pay** – Get paid every Friday.

The Bay Club Operations Associate is an exciting opportunity to gain experience across multiple areas of Club operations while creating memorable experiences for members and guests every day. It's more than a support role; Associates contribute to the overall success of the Club by supporting hospitality, fitness, facility operations, and member services. This role provides a unique opportunity to explore different departments, build valuable skills, and discover potential career paths within the organization. Bay Club Associates are expected to deliver outstanding service, uphold safety and cleanliness standards, support daily Club operations, and bring a positive, energetic, and professional attitude to every interaction.

Respect The Past



Accept Responsibility



Pay it Forward
